cells.gaps: A register of payers is shown in one commune only, Nyanza (September 2026); elsewhere E-TAXE and IBB M+ record payments only, and the Interior ministry still called E-TAXE's twelve communes pilots in February 2026 (BDI-023). The 30 communes digitalised carry no total; the 2021 denominator of 119 communes predates the 2025 reform to 42 and is not used. Owner disagrees: the ministry (BDI-025), a bank (BDI-012) and a partner for Nyanza (BDI-030).
cells.note: Electronic collection is live outside the capital, in Kayanza and a count of 30 communes, and Nyanza keeps a taxpayer register in its accounting software (BDI-027): stage 3. Stage 4 needs a register in more than half of communes, and only one is shown with one.
